title: Neural Development & Lineage Atlas — Neural Tube to Adult House, Brainstem and Ladder
purpose: Explain how the adult BODY rooms arise from embryonic patterning so adult anatomy is understood as a developmental transformation rather than a static parts list.

core_sequence.process: Ectodermal neural plate is specified and folds toward a neural tube.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Establishes the continuous CNS precursor before brain/spinal regionalization.

core_sequence.process: Neural folds elevate and fuse; closure proceeds while neural crest separates and migrates.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Neural tube produces CNS; neural crest contributes many PNS neurons/glia plus non-neural derivatives.

core_sequence.process: Rostral neural tube forms prosencephalon, mesencephalon and rhombencephalon.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: First major regional partition of forebrain, midbrain and hindbrain.

core_sequence.process: Prosencephalon subdivides into telencephalon+diencephalon; rhombencephalon into metencephalon+myelencephalon; mesencephalon persists.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Creates developmental owners for cortex/basal ganglia, thalamus/hypothalamus/epithalamus, midbrain, pons/cerebellum and medulla.

core_sequence.process: Neuroepithelial progenitors line the ventricular zone and transition into radial glial progenitors.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Ventricular surfaces are developmental germinal interfaces, not empty leftover cavities.

core_sequence.process: Radial glia and intermediate progenitors generate neurons; cortical excitatory neurons migrate radially, producing an inside-out cortical layering pattern.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Adult laminae encode developmental birth order and migration history.

core_sequence.process: Many cortical inhibitory interneurons arise in ventral telencephalic germinal zones and migrate tangentially into cortex.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Cortical cell identity cannot be understood as purely local radial lineage.

core_sequence.process: Progenitors later generate astrocytic and oligodendroglial lineages; microglia arise from a distinct myeloid lineage rather than neuroectoderm.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: The adult CNS is a mixed-lineage cellular ecosystem.

core_sequence.process: Growing axons respond to molecular guidance cues and activity-dependent refinement.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Adult white-matter roads are developmentally constructed trajectories, not wires inserted after regions form.

core_sequence.process: Connections proliferate, stabilize, prune and myelinate over prolonged developmental periods.
core_sequence.adult_relevance: Circuit architecture remains developmentally plastic well beyond gross anatomical formation.

vesicle_map.project_neighbor: upper distributed rooms / memory / affect / action selection

dorsal_ventral_patterning.principle: Neural tube dorsal-ventral identities are patterned by opposing signaling systems, classically including dorsal BMP/TGF-β-family influence and ventral Sonic hedgehog influence from notochord/floor plate.
dorsal_ventral_patterning.consequence: Sensory-processing territories become broadly dorsal and motor territories broadly ventral in spinal cord; the opened brainstem rearranges these columns around the fourth ventricle.
dorsal_ventral_patterning.project_use: Explains why the cranial/brainstem functional-column atlas and spinal dorsal/ventral rooms share a developmental grammar.
dorsal_ventral_patterning.boundary: Developmental morphogen gradients are molecular mechanisms, not spiritual ascent/descent forces.

neural_crest_bridge.role: Neural crest emigrates from neural-fold borders and contributes extensively to peripheral sensory/autonomic ganglia, Schwann cells and other derivatives.
neural_crest_bridge.integration: Provides developmental continuity between central Ladder and peripheral roots/ganglia without implying that CNS and PNS share identical mature cell architecture.

developmental_questions: Which adult House rooms share diencephalic developmental lineage?
How does opening of the fourth ventricle rotate/reposition brainstem sensory and motor columns?
How do spinal cord segments and peripheral ganglia acquire distinct rostrocaudal identities?
How does prolonged human cortical development reshape simple adult room labels?
Which project symbolic boundaries accidentally confuse developmental ancestry with adult function?
boundaries: Embryological ancestry does not determine one fixed adult function.
Human cortical development has species-specific timing and progenitor features; rodent developmental maps are informative but not complete human substitutes.
Microglia have a distinct myeloid developmental origin and should not be grouped with neural-tube-derived glia.
Neural crest and neural tube are developmentally adjacent but yield different mature structures.

sources.topic: human brain developmental genetics and radial glia
